name: My ne zabudem eto leto
source:
This story is an attempt to make something different from the usual mods from someone tired of the same cliches. It's going to feature a different Semyon, Lena, Alisa, and even a different Shurik!
All that for the sake of trying to create something light and amusing. A romantic comedy of sorts.

Semyon, a typical 80s student, ends up in the Sovyonok camp as a counselor. This is the story of his adventures there.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=866974585]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这个故事是一个尝试，让厌倦了相同陈词滥调的人制作出与通常的模组不同的东西。它将以不同的Semyon、Lena、Alisa甚至不同的Shurik为特色！
所有这一切都是为了尝试创造一些轻松有趣的东西。一部浪漫喜剧。

谢苗是一名典型的80年代学生，最终在Sovyonok营地担任辅导员。这是他在那里的冒险故事。

[翻译和编辑自 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=866974585]Steam[/url]]
